title: Microsoft 365 Security Baseline & Audit Readiness (Secure Score / Compliance Manager)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (M365 tenant secure-configuration baseline + control evidence + audit readiness across services; Secure Score, Compliance Manager, framework mapping).
Distinct from the CIS/STIG ENDPOINT baselines; this is the M365 TENANT/service configuration + audit-evidence layer. version_directive: New; branding: off.
hook: Harden the Microsoft 365 tenant to a real baseline — and walk into the audit with evidence in hand
problem: Most Microsoft 365 tenants are configured to 'it works', not 'it's secure' — and when an audit or a framework assessment lands, nobody can show the controls are in place. This solution delivers a repeatable Microsoft 365 security baseline and audit-readiness program: harden the tenant and services to a documented baseline (improving Secure Score), map controls to recognized frameworks with Compliance Manager, and maintain the control evidence so audit readiness is continuous, not a fire drill.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the M365 secure-configuration baseline (identity, email, collaboration, device, data services), Microsoft Secure Score, Compliance Manager and control mapping to recognized frameworks, and the control-evidence model.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Microsoft 365 + relevant security/compliance licensing, Entra ID, the target framework(s), a baseline owner, a pilot scope) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: assess current Secure Score and configuration, apply the secure-configuration baseline across services, map controls in Compliance Manager to the framework, capture control evidence, validate, then maintain on a review cadence.

5 PowerShell scripts — M365 secure-config + Secure Score discovery, baseline-compliance validation, a Secure Score + control-evidence report, safe remediation of baseline gaps, and a baseline-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable Microsoft 365 security baseline and audit-readiness program — harden the tenant to a documented baseline (improving Secure Score), map controls to frameworks with Compliance Manager, and maintain control evidence. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
